Requirement/track:
Execution contract or issue contract:

## Scope and coordination

State the observable outcome, dependency evidence, owned paths and material exclusions. Identify the integration owner and any disjoint tracks combined here. Keep claim tokens and local coordination state out of the PR. Explain schema/migration, rollback or recovery implications when relevant.

## Validation

Record the exact final head/base or tested tree. List focused checks, relevant regressions and required CI with actual results and evidence links. Include representative failure/recovery cases and fixes/retests. Distinguish deterministic fixtures, skipped tests, actual live inference, host launches and platform builds.

## Independent review and delivery

Request an independent review of the exact final revision. Resolve blocking findings, retest and obtain fresh review after changes. Merge only after all required checks pass and conversations are resolved. Verify remote merge/issue closure; record user-outcome acceptance separately from PR count. Report unknown timing/quality metrics honestly; do not infer completion from an open PR or a generic green build.
